title: Spatially resolved dust properties and quasar-galaxy decomposition of a hyper-luminous infrared galaxy at z = 4.4
question: Derive resolved dust temperature maps of the z=4.4 quasar host BRI 1335-0417, separate AGN-heated warm dust (unresolved point source) from star-formation-heated cold dust, and re-estimate the SFR and SFR surface density

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and line cubes
recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, continuum from line-free channels with linear fit subtraction, then imaging with Briggs weighting; line maps by summing channels and per-pixel single Gaussian fits
key_parameters: line maps from summing channels over -400 to 400 km/s; pixels kept if detected above 4 sigma in at least 4 channels

recipe.goal: Match resolution of all images and cubes
recipe.method: Convolve to the smallest common beam
key_parameters: same phase centre and pixel size used for all data products

recipe.goal: Fit the global (spatially integrated) SED with a single greybody
recipe.method: Integrate flux in a 2 arcsec x 2 arcsec box, then fit a single optically thin greybody (T, M_dust, beta free) to the photometry; 160 um Herschel point excluded because of warm dust excess
key_parameters: Herschel SPIRE 350 and 500 um excluded because of blending
assumptions: gas-to-dust ratio uses Jones et al. CO(2-1) gas mass with alpha_CO = 0.8 and r21 = 0.85

recipe.goal: Derive per-pixel dust temperature and surface density maps
recipe.method: Fit a CMB-corrected greybody to rest-frame 161 and 90 um images in each pixel with beta fixed at the global value, solving for Sigma_dust and T_dust
key_parameters: Band 4 (385 um) not used for the resolved fit because of lowest sensitivity
only pixels with 68% interval on T_dust below 10 K kept
assumptions: kappa_0 = 5.1 cm^2/g at 1199.1 GHz (Draine & Li 2007); CMB temperature correction at z = 4.4704

recipe.goal: Radial temperature profile and gas-tracer profile comparison
recipe.method: De-project radius with thin-disk geometry from [C II] kinematics; compare dust-derived, CO(7-6)-derived and [C II]-derived gas profiles normalised at about 2 kpc
key_parameters: CO comparison done at common 0.24 x 0.18 arcsec resolution
assumptions: constant emissivity per unit mass for line tracers; constant dust-to-gas ratio for dust

recipe.goal: Test systematics of the resolved measurements
recipe.method: Vary absolute flux scales by 10% in opposite directions and vary beta over 1 to 2.5 to see effect on temperature and dust mass profiles

recipe.goal: Decompose Band 7 and Band 9 continuum images into point source plus host
recipe.method: Fit three components (PSF-scaled point source, PSF-convolved circular Gaussian, and a [C II] moment-0 template for the disk) to each continuum image
key_parameters: [C II] cube convolved to continuum resolution; masked moment: kernel 2x beam and 2x channel width, mask threshold = rms of original cube
assumptions: [C II] moment map traces the distribution of star-formation-heated dust

recipe.goal: Fit the SED of AGN-heated and host dust using the decomposition
recipe.method: Fit two greybodies (optically thin, then cold dust with free tau_161um) simultaneously to integrated SED and to point-source fluxes at 161 and 90 um; also run modified STARDUST panchromatic fits
key_parameters: Optically thin model has 6 free parameters (T, M_dust, beta for each component)
Adopted final values: two greybodies with free optical thickness for cold component
assumptions: AGN-heated dust modelled as optically thin greybody with free beta, instead of torus models

recipe.goal: Make AGN-subtracted dust maps and SFR surface density
recipe.method: Subtract best-fit point-source model from the 161 and 90 um images and repeat the per-pixel greybody fit; convert Sigma_TIR to Sigma_SFR
key_parameters: same fiducial beta = 2.14 +/- 0.17; Monte Carlo includes point-source parameter uncertainties
assumptions: Chabrier IMF in the TIR to SFR conversion

recipe.method: Convert dust mass surface density to gas surface density with the global gas-to-dust ratio and plot against AGN-subtracted Sigma_SFR per pixel
